scope: Assistant analysis of primary publisher pages accessed 2026-10-18. All emotional values are proposals; no human review. No reproduced descriptions. Work-level not ROM identification.

games.facts: Mario and Luigi cross stages, use Yoshi and a cape, and solve stage obstacles.
games.rationale: Stage boundaries suggest short visits; secrets invite exploration. This does not establish a save state or a personal feeling.
games.explanation: Una aventura por etapas, con caminos que invitan a explorar.

games.facts: Yoshi uses eggs and transformations across six worlds; Nintendo describes hand-drawn picture-book visuals.
games.rationale: Picture-book presentation suggests gentleness, while aiming and platforming still demand attention.
games.explanation: Un viaje de dibujo y exploración, con pequeños retos por el camino.

games.facts: Kart races and battles, eight drivers and items that affect opponents.
games.rationale: Discrete races can suit a short visit; items and opponents suggest lively attention. No exact session duration is inferred.
games.explanation: Carreras e imprevistos para una visita breve y con ritmo.

games.facts: Fields and dungeons, tools including bow and bombs, and puzzles solved with different actions.
games.rationale: Tools and dungeon puzzles support an exploratory interpretation; remembering objectives can take effort after a break.
games.explanation: Campos y mazmorras para descubrir caminos y resolver enigmas.

games.facts: Samus explores Zebes; equipment found along the route expands movement and attack options.
games.rationale: Unknown routes and growing abilities suggest mystery and discovery; danger means it is not simply a calming night game.
games.explanation: Un planeta por explorar, con rutas que cambian al encontrar nuevas habilidades.

games.facts: Flight combat with teammates and manoeuvres such as rolling and reverse thrust, in polygonal space.
games.rationale: Pilot manoeuvres and combat suggest a brisk demanding visit; no claim of exact mission duration.
games.explanation: Combate y maniobras de vuelo para un momento de acción concentrada.

games.facts: Four machines race on fifteen circuits with damaging barriers and slippery surfaces.
games.rationale: Fast racing and hazardous tracks suggest intensity, while separate races offer brief opportunities.
games.explanation: Circuitos y precisión al volante para una sesión con energía.

games.facts: Flight exercises use a biplane, skydiving, hang-glider and rocket belt; precision landing matters.
games.rationale: Flight setting may feel open and quiet, but scoring precise landings prevents classifying it as effortless.
games.explanation: Pequeños ejercicios de vuelo que dejan espacio a la precisión.

games.facts: Kirby is struck into enemies to turn them into stars; the last enemy becomes a cup, with strokes counted as score.
games.rationale: Choosing shots suggests thought before action; the presence of hazards and vitality prevents an assumption of complete relaxation.
games.explanation: Un pequeño problema de trayectorias para pensar antes de lanzar.

games.facts: Arthur uses multiple weapons and a double jump against monsters; terrain changes and difficulty is explicitly discussed.
games.rationale: Challenging monster encounters support tension. Gothic context can suggest Halloween, without imposing it or forbidding other dates.
games.explanation: Acción exigente entre criaturas y escenarios cambiantes.

games.facts: Firebrand flies, breathes fire and assumes six forms; the quest has three endings.
games.rationale: Changing forms and different endings suggest discovery; the demon setting supports a possible autumn atmosphere, not a universal emotion.
games.explanation: Formas y caminos por descubrir en una aventura de atmósfera oscura.

games.facts: Ryu can transform into a powerful beast and is accompanied by seven companions with animal powers.
games.rationale: A party quest suggests sustained involvement and remembering abilities. No total playtime or battle mode is asserted by this evidence.
games.explanation: Una aventura de compañeros y transformaciones para seguir con tiempo.

games.facts: Six different modes, helpers with different abilities, and subgames based on timed or rapid button presses.
games.rationale: Multiple modes and subgames suggest flexible short visits; cooperative possibilities are not taken as reduced challenge.
games.explanation: Pequeñas aventuras y habilidades distintas para elegir tu propio ritmo.

games.facts: A wide world, missing family, allies, shaman fusion and dragon transformations.
games.rationale: A missing-family quest supports mystery; managing a continuing party adventure can require reacquaintance after a break.
games.explanation: Un mundo amplio y una búsqueda que empieza con una desaparición.

games.facts: Swap horizontal neighbours; align at least three panels and continue chains while panels disappear.
games.rationale: Active chain building is mentally busy despite colourful presentation; separate puzzle rounds can suit brief sessions.
games.explanation: Puzles de cadenas activas que piden atención y rapidez.

games.facts: SNES third-person shooting against outlaws and robots, including large bosses and two-player co-op.
games.rationale: Arcade-style encounters suggest compact high-energy visits; no assumption about personal preference for action.
games.explanation: Forajidos, robots y acción concentrada para probar otro ritmo.

games.facts: Donkey and Diddy exchange the lead, overcome obstacles and ride animals with distinct abilities.
games.rationale: Distinct stage obstacles suggest rhythmic action and manageable visits, not a fixed easy difficulty.
games.explanation: Dos compañeros y habilidades animales para cruzar nuevos obstáculos.

games.facts: Grid puzzles reveal pictures, with a save function for returning to unfinished puzzles.
games.rationale: Grid deduction suggests slow concentration and interruption-friendly play. Documented original save is not evidence of a personal saved file.
games.explanation: Un dibujo escondido entre números para resolver sin prisa.

games.facts: Ness travels through towns with companions, explores and shops; battles combine weapons and psychic powers.
games.rationale: Town exploration and an unusual journey suggest curiosity, but battles and story memory rule out universally calm or easy-to-resume labels.
games.explanation: Pueblos y encuentros extraños en una aventura de compañeros.

games.facts: Grow crops, raise animals and visit a town for tools and supplies.
games.rationale: Repeated farm tasks may feel grounded; resource decisions still require attention. No exact day or session duration inferred.
games.explanation: Una granja que cuidar, entre pequeños trabajos y decisiones cotidianas.

games.facts: Move blocks by sucking and spitting them to build routes towards rainbow pieces; levels allow different solutions.
games.rationale: Route planning and discrete levels suggest considered short visits; calm is an interpretation, not a documented response.
games.explanation: Construir un camino con bloques, probando una idea cada vez.
